sections.title: Scope & Universal Application
content: This Universal Privacy Policy applies to all mobile games, mobile utility applications, productivity tools, digital products, and online services published by **Coreplay Technologies** ("we", "our", or "us") on Google Play and authorized Android marketplaces.

We are committed to protecting user privacy through a strict privacy-by-design framework. Across our entire portfolio, our core philosophy is data minimization: sensitive operations (such as optical code recognition, task scheduling, text styling, and game artificial intelligence) execute strictly on-device wherever technically feasible. We never sell, harvest, or monetize your personal files, schedule entries, gameplay records, or scan logs.

**Dedicated Application Policies:** In addition to this Universal Policy, Coreplay Technologies maintains verified app-specific privacy policies detailing exact permissions, local storage formats, and third-party SDKs for each application. You can review individual application policies directly at `/privacy-policy/[appname]` (including `/privacy-policy/text-repeater`, `/privacy-policy/todo-list`, `/privacy-policy/tic-tac-toe`, `/privacy-policy/nickname-app`, and `/privacy-policy/qr-banner-scanner`).

sections.title: Device Permissions & System Access
content: To deliver core utility, productivity, and gaming features, our applications may request access to specific Android device hardware and system capabilities. These permissions are requested at runtime only when strictly necessary:

- **Camera & Optical Sensors (android.permission.CAMERA):** Requested strictly in optical scanning utilities to provide a real-time optical viewfinder for scanning QR codes and barcodes using Google ML Kit. **Zero Cloud Video Transmission:** Video frames captured by your camera are analyzed strictly in real time in volatile device memory and discarded immediately. We do not record, photograph, store, or transmit camera feeds or photos to external servers.
- **Flashlight Assist (android.permission.FLASHLIGHT):** Used optionally to toggle your device flashlight so you can scan barcodes and QR codes in dark or low-light conditions.

- **Local Photos, Media & Storage (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / Filesystem):** Requested only when you voluntarily choose to scan an existing QR code or barcode from your saved photo gallery, or when you explicitly export data logs (such as CSV or text files) or save generated QR graphics and backup files to your device storage.

- **System Clipboard Access:** Enables you to copy decoded barcode data, Wi-Fi credentials, URLs, styled fonts, or gamer handles to your clipboard with a single tap, or paste text to generate custom codes. Clipboard interactions are user-initiated and processed strictly locally.

- **Haptic Feedback & Vibration (android.permission.VIBRATE):** Delivers tactile confirmation upon user interactions (such as button taps, task completion celebrations, turn indicators, and code scan confirmations) and for notification reminder vibrations.

- **Post Notifications (android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS):** Requested in task planning, reminder utilities, or games on Android 13+ to deliver user-scheduled task reminder alerts, deadline notifications, and focus nudges. Notifications are scheduled strictly through local on-device alarms, and users can toggle or configure notification timing at any time within application or system settings.

- **Boot Completed (android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED):** Used in reminder utilities strictly to restore and reschedule active user-defined task reminders when the Android device is restarted, ensuring scheduled alerts are preserved without running persistent background tracking services.

- **Network & Internet State (android.permission.INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE):** Used in online or ad-supported releases to deliver advertisements via verified ad networks, check license verification via Google Play, and open external web links in your preferred browser when you tap on an external URL or resource. Standalone offline utilities and titles do not transmit user data across external networks.

- **Zero Invasive Permissions:** Coreplay applications never request access to personal contact lists, microphone audio, call logs, SMS messages, or background location tracking unless essential for the application's stated primary function.
You can manage, grant, or revoke any of these permissions at any time through your Android device settings (**Settings > Apps > [App Name] > Permissions**).

sections.title: Information Collection and Use
content: When you download, install, and interact with our applications and games, certain technical and diagnostic data may be automatically collected based on the application category:
- **Device Technical Identifiers:** Device model, manufacturer, Android operating system version, system language, screen resolution, and available memory for technical compatibility and stability.

- **Diagnostic & Performance Data:** Application launch timestamps, session duration, in-game level progress, crash logs, and stability metrics to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance across devices.

- **Advertising Identifiers:** Non-permanent device identifiers such as the Google Advertising ID (GAID), used in ad-supported titles to measure advertising attribution, prevent fraud, and manage frequency capping.

- **Approximate Geographic Location:** Non-precise, coarse location derived from IP address (e.g. country or metropolitan area) used in ad-supported titles for regional advertising compliance, language localization, and fraud prevention. **We do not collect precise GPS coordinates.**

- **Local User Content & Personal Data Sovereignty:** In all our utility tools, productivity applications, and casual board games, all user content—including task titles, notes, subtask checklists, schedules, categories, scan history, player preferences, and text repeats—is stored **strictly locally on your device** (via on-device Preferences and local storage). They are never synced to our servers without your explicit action, never transmitted externally, and never accessible to third parties.

- **No Account Registration or Cloud Profiles:** Standalone utilities and casual games published by Coreplay Technologies require no account creation, sign-up, email login, or passwords. You remain completely anonymous.

sections.title: Third-Party Services & SDK Integrations
content: Our applications and games integrate trusted third-party Software Development Kits (SDKs) based on the specific application's functionality. Each provider processes data in accordance with their respective privacy policies:
- **Google Play Services (Google LLC):** Essential for Android app distribution, security verification, and operating system integration. [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)

- **Google AdMob & Mobile Ads SDK (Google LLC):** Delivers banner, interstitial, app-open, and rewarded video advertisements in ad-supported titles. AdMob may collect and process device advertising IDs (GAID), IP address, and interaction data to serve relevant ads and prevent fraud. [Google AdMob Privacy Policy](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6128543)

- **Google ML Kit (Google LLC):** Powers high-speed on-device computer vision for barcode and QR code recognition in scanner utilities. Machine learning inference occurs 100% locally on your phone's processor without sending image frames to Google servers. [Google ML Kit Terms](https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms)

- **Unity Technologies (Unity Ads & Engine):** Provides 3D graphics rendering, realistic physics simulation, and in-game ad delivery for mobile simulation games. [Unity Privacy Policy](https://unity.com/legal/privacy-policy)

- **Firebase & Crashlytics (Google LLC):** Aggregated crash analytics and performance monitoring used in simulation games to troubleshoot device-specific crashes and optimize frame rates. [Firebase Privacy Policy](https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy)

- **Open-Source Reference APIs (e.g., Open Food Facts):** Optional reference lookup services queried solely for commercial retail barcode information when explicitly enabled by the user without logging user profiles.

- **Standalone Offline Titles:** Certain applications published by Coreplay Technologies operate as 100% standalone, offline applications. They do not integrate third-party advertising SDKs, analytics tracking libraries (such as Firebase or Crashlytics), or remote cloud databases. All task scheduling and data persistence execute strictly on the client device.

sections.title: Managing Advertising Choices & Advertising ID
content: Our free-to-download mobile games and ad-supported apps may display advertisements powered by Google AdMob and certified ad networks. You have complete control over personalized advertising through your Android operating system settings:
- **Reset Advertising ID:** Open Android **Settings > Google > Ads** and tap **Reset advertising ID** to disassociate past activity from your device identifier.

- **Delete Advertising ID:** On modern Android versions (Android 12+), navigate to **Settings > Google > Ads** and tap **Delete advertising ID** to prevent apps from accessing your advertising identifier entirely.
- **Opt-Out of Personalized Ads:** Toggle **Opt out of Ads Personalization** in your Google settings to ensure you receive contextual ads rather than interest-based ads.
- **Ad-Free Rewarded Options:** Select applications provide options to watch an optional rewarded video ad to enjoy an extended ad-free period without making financial purchases.

sections.title: In-App Purchases & Financial Data
content: If our games or applications offer optional in-app purchases, digital unlocks, or subscriptions, all payment transactions are handled exclusively through the **Google Play In-App Billing** system.

Coreplay Technologies does not collect, receive, or store your credit card numbers, bank account information, or billing address. All financial details are processed securely by Google under [Google Payments Privacy Notice](https://payments.google.com/legaldocument?family=0.privacynotice).
- **Free & Non-Monetized Utilities:** Non-monetized utilities published by Coreplay Technologies are completely free to use with no hidden fees, paid subscriptions, or financial transactions.

sections.title: Data Retention & User Data Deletion Rights
content: In compliance with Google Play Store Developer Policies and international privacy regulations, we provide clear procedures for managing and deleting your data:

- **Local Data Erasure & App Reset:** You can permanently delete your data instantly at any time from within our applications. You can clear task databases, wipe scan history, reset match statistics, or clear your saved favorites directly in application settings. You can also clear all stored data instantly at the operating system level through Android system settings (**Settings > Apps > [App Name] > Storage > Clear Data**).

- **Data Portability & Backup:** Applications supporting data export provide full data portability, enabling you to export your data (such as JSON backups or CSV logs) at any time for local preservation or device transfer without server intervention.

- **Account & Support Data Deletion Request:** If you have contacted our support team or submitted diagnostic feedback, you have the right to request the permanent erasure of all associated correspondence and records.

- **How to Request Deletion:** Send an email to **{{contactEmail}}** with the subject line **[Data Deletion Request]** specifying the application name and your details. We verify and complete all data deletion requests within 30 days without charge.

sections.title: Children's Privacy & Families Policy
content: Coreplay Technologies complies with the **Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA)**, GDPR-K, and Google Play Families Policies.

Our applications and games are designed for general audiences and are not directed to children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in the European Economic Area). We do not knowingly solicit, collect, or store personal information from children under 13 years of age.

If we become aware that personal information has been mistakenly collected from a child under 13 without verifiable parental consent, we will take immediate steps to permanently remove such data from our systems. Parents and legal guardians may contact us directly at **{{contactEmail}}** for prompt assistance.

sections.title: Your Global Privacy Rights (GDPR & CCPA/CPRA)
content: Depending on your geographic jurisdiction, you hold specific legal rights concerning your personal data:

- **European Economic Area (EEA) & UK Users (GDPR):** You have the right to access your personal data, request rectification of inaccurate data, request erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"), restrict or object to data processing, and request data portability.

- **California Residents (CCPA / CPRA):** You have the right to know what personal information is collected, request deletion of your information, and be free from discriminatory treatment for exercising your rights.
- **"Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information":** Coreplay Technologies **does not sell, rent, or trade** personal information to third parties for monetary or valuable consideration.
To exercise any of these statutory rights, please contact our privacy representative at **{{contactEmail}}**.

sections.title: Offline Functionality & Privacy by Design
content: Our utility applications and standalone casual titles are designed to operate independently of an active internet connection whenever possible.

All task planning, scheduling, reminder calculations, barcode scanning, QR code decoding, text styling, and tactical board game calculations (including Minimax AI decision-making, move replay review, and streak validation) execute entirely locally on your device hardware without requiring an internet connection. Your schedules, tasks, and private notes remain your private property on your physical device.

sections.title: Data Security
content: We implement industry-standard technical, procedural, and administrative safeguards to protect any diagnostic information collected against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. All communication with third-party service providers (such as Google Play and AdMob) is encrypted in transit using Transport Layer Security (TLS/HTTPS).
Local application storage is protected by Android's application sandbox architecture.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
content: We may update our Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our applications, newly published titles, operating system requirements, or legal regulations. We will notify you of any revisions by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.

We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how Coreplay Technologies protects your information. Continued use of our mobile applications and games after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.title: Contact Us
content: If you have any questions, suggestions, or data requests regarding this Universal Privacy Policy or the privacy practices of Coreplay Technologies, please contact our Privacy Team:
- **Developer / Publisher:** Coreplay Technologies
- **Support & Privacy Email:** {{contactEmail}}
- **Google Play Profile:** [Coreplay Technologies on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6807992577867877190)
- **Response Time:** We strive to acknowledge and resolve all privacy inquiries within 48 to 72 business hours.
